capabilities: Create P-set notes from a sidebar form (class, set number, problem count)
Create P-set notes from a modal command
Configure class list, filename pattern, and date/time formats in settings
Define full-note and per-problem structures with tokens like {{problems}} and {{n}}
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. README ends with a 'Core Templates help' section that appears truncated. The sidebar does not open by itself.
motivation: Built around how P-sets work at MIT, where an assignment is defined by a class, a set number, and N problems.
problem: Obsidian's core Templates inserts static text and has no form-driven way to generate homework notes structured as a class, set number, and numbered problem sections.
summary: Sidebar and modal that create problem-set notes from class, P-set number, and problem count using configurable templates.
